directions.plain: You run a short sale for one week. Shoppers who were waiting buy in that week.
directions.title: One Week Gift Sale Push
directions.why_for_you: Last month your own posts held up even when creators went quiet. A short sale builds on that steady interest during gift time.
directions.you_would_do: Post daily that week using your on-hand photos and pick one week to discount.

directions.plain: You pay to show your best photos to more women like your buyers. You start fast and stop when you want.
directions.title: Boost Best Posts to Shoppers
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand photos earn the most love from shoppers. This puts money behind what already works.
directions.you_would_do: Post three to five times a week with mostly on-hand shots and pick two to boost.

directions.plain: You post often and spend nothing. Growth is slow but safe.
directions.title: Steady Posts With No Spending
directions.why_for_you: Your own posts held steady last month when creators did not. Our past checks missed some weeks so keep hopes steady.
directions.you_would_do: Post four to five times a week using mostly on-hand and close-up photos.

directions.caution: Last month only one of four creators posted so this can be slow and quiet.
directions.plain: You send pieces to small creators who wear them. They post wearing photos if they like them.
directions.title: Gift Pieces to Small Creators
directions.why_for_you: Posts from creators often bring lots of kind comments. Your on-hand photos show wearing shots work for you.
directions.you_would_do: Message ten new creators and send pieces to four to eight who reply.

season_note: December brings strong gift demand at 2.23 with pricier ads at 1.27.
